title: Classification of recruitment agents
chapter: Chapter III — Recruitment Agents, Licence, and such others
text: Classification of recruitment agents.— (1) The Government may classify the recruitment agents in a prescriptive graded manner. (2) The classification into various grades shall be done based on an evaluation of the conditions that must be met by the recruitment agents. (3) The factors to be considered while classifying the recruitment agents into various grades under this Section shall be prescribed by the Rules.
source: Overseas Employment and Migrants Act 2013 (official English translation)
